name: Make Sunsets

summary.text: Make Sunsets is a US startup founded by Luke Iseman that releases sulfur dioxide into the stratosphere by weather balloon and sells 'cooling credits' for the claimed effect. After it launched balloons in Baja California Sur without permission, Mexico's environment ministry Semarnat and science council Conacyt announced on January 13, 2023 that the country would prohibit solar-geoengineering experiments; the company said its launch plans were on hold.

facts.claim: Semarnat and Conacyt issued a joint statement on January 13, 2023 announcing a prohibition on solar-geoengineering experiments, noting the absence of international regulation or supervisory frameworks.
facts.quote: Semarnat and Conacyt issued a joint statement on January 13 announcing the prohibition, pointing out that there are no international regulations or supervisory frameworks addressing geoengineering projects.
